resources.string: Shows that real-time protection is running. Required by Android for a background service.
Warnings about harmful or suspicious apps and downloaded APK files.
Checking every app you install or update
Checking new apps and downloaded APK files
BlackShield checked this app as it was installed.
Found in the downloaded file %1$s. It is not installed: do not install it.
Real-time protection runs in the background. Some settings and some phone makers stop background apps; this page checks for them.
Everything looks good. Real-time protection can keep running.
New apps and downloads are not checked until you turn it on.
It is switched on, but the system stopped it. Restart it, then check the items below.
BlackShield cannot warn you about a harmful app while its notifications are off.
The \"Threat warnings\" notification category is off, so warnings would not appear.
Android stops restricted apps in the background. In App info, open Battery (or App battery usage) and choose \"Unrestricted\" or \"Optimized\".
The system may pause protection to save battery. Choose BlackShield in the list and select \"Don\'t optimize\" or \"Unrestricted\". Protection is event-driven and uses very little battery.
Open the app now and then, or make sure background use is not limited in App info.
Checking downloaded APK files is on, but BlackShield cannot see the Download folder. Allow \"All files access\" for BlackShield.
Your phone maker may stop background apps
On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, turn on Autostart for BlackShield and set Battery saver to \"No restrictions\". You can also lock BlackShield in the recent apps screen.
On Huawei and Honor phones, open App launch and set BlackShield to \"Manage manually\" with auto-launch, secondary launch and run in background all on.
On Samsung phones, make sure BlackShield is not in \"Sleeping apps\" or \"Deep sleeping apps\" (Battery > Background usage limits), and add it to \"Never sleeping apps\".
On OnePlus phones, allow auto-launch for BlackShield and set its battery usage to \"Don\'t optimize\".
On OPPO and realme phones, allow auto-launch and background activity for BlackShield in the startup manager and battery settings.
On vivo and iQOO phones, allow background start and high background power consumption for BlackShield.
